title: (RHBA-2013:1489) Red Hat Access enablement
portal_summary:
Enables Red Hat Access through a new plug-in. Several other bug fixes are
included for SAM 1.3
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|6|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously-released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

To apply this update, upgrade the SAM instance as described in the 
documentation:
https://access.redhat.com/site/documentation/en-US/Red_Hat_Subscription_Management/1/html/Using_Subscription_Asset_Manager/sam-upgrade.html
portal_description:
This update to Red Hat Subscription Asset Manager adds several enhancements
that improve the ability to find help resources and obtain support.

Red Hat Subscription Asset Manager acts as an on-premise service to manage
subscription information and works as a proxy for software updates on
client machines.

This release includes this important new feature:

* A new plug-in, Red Hat Access, is introduced which integrates knowledge
resources from the Customer Portal into a SAM instance. Red Hat Access
includes a search mechanism to search Portal knowledgebase articles through
the SAM UI. The new search tool is available as soon as SAM is upgraded and
the katello service is restarted. Additional information is available at
https://access.redhat.com/site/articles/524483. (BZ#1004472)

All users of Subscription Asset Manager 1.3 are encouraged to upgrade to these
new packages.
